title: A Gravity for the Static
author: Hazel Crane
blurb: Paloma Nystrom, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
